prompt: WHITE-LINE WOOD ENGRAVING / scratchboard illustration. The image is SOLID BLACK, and every form is revealed by FINE WHITE CARVED LINES cut out of that black — dense parallel line shading, stippling, contour cuts that follow the shape of each object, radiating cut lines where light falls. No grey washes, no gradients, no soft glow: only black, white carved line, and ONE accent of SATURATED WARM GOLD used exclusively for light sources. Bold graphic composition, high contrast, hand-cut irregularity. No text, no lettering, no signage, no runes. A tiny village of small cabins in a forest at night, utterly dwarfed by enormous ferns, grass blades and a fallen pine cone bigger than the buildings — all carved in fine white line against solid black. The cabins windows and open doorways are FLAT SATURATED GOLD shapes, the only colour in the image. Two tiny beings stand in the lane: solid black shapes defined by a thin carved WHITE RIM-LIGHT along their edges, featureless, read only by posture; one holds a small gold point of light. Vast scale, tiny settlement.
